name: Kotohira Kaho
source:
Age: early 20s

Yukito’s childhood friend and Asuna’s romantic rival.
Like the siblings, she belongs to a theater troupe, but unlike Asuna, she is a dedicated professional who is solely focused on acting.
At first glance, she comes across as a no-nonsense, big-sister type who’s always looking out for others, but deep down, she has a girlish side that cares about Yukito more than anyone else.
“Even though I know Yukito’s heart isn’t with me, I still want him to notice me someday… but is it really okay to keep acting with such impure motives?” She spends her days agonizing over this.
